forestmap: Visualising Multiple Sources of Meta-Analytic Heterogeneity

Source: R/forestmap-package.R
forestmap-package.Rd

Draws a forest plot of the studies in a meta-analysis, sorted by effect size, above a heatmap of study properties such as population, design or country. Supply one row per study (effect size and 95
